prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Verify Your Pet Photo Quality", "Ensure clear lighting and a single visible pet before rendering."]
1: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Try calling your pet and using system tray shortcuts before concluding setup.", "Click me to practice desktop pet actions!", "Practice summon, hide, and call commands"]
2: ["Testing Desktop Display Compatibility", "Verifying overlay permissions while your companion renders."]
3: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Choose Instant Companion for speed or Custom Studio for total personalization.", "Instant vs Custom Path"]
4: ["Secure Your Pet's Unique Memories", "Sign in to bind your pet's custom traits and progress safely to your cloud account.", "Prevents lost pets or account resets when switching devices."]
5: ["Meet Your Potential Companions", "Preview behaviors and voice clips before finalizing your adoption.", "Listen to sound samples"]
6: ["Your Virtual Desktop Companion Awaits", "Adopt an animated pet that lives on your screen, reacts to your work, and keeps you company.", "Start Adoption Journey"]
7: ["Your Pet is Arriving!", "Play with temporary desktop treats while background setup completes.", "Feed pet treats while loading"]
8: ["Desktop Pet Desktop Control Cheat Sheet", "Your companion sits in your system tray. Right-click anytime to access controls or hide.", "Hotkey: Ctrl+Shift+P summons pet instantly to your cursor position."]
9: ["Custom Pet Photo Requirements", "Upload 1 to 3 clear photos. Custom rendering takes approximately 60 seconds.", "Clear single pet photos ensure the best 3D desktop model conversion."]
